snippet.title: Date or Destiny: Kiss or Miss // Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the Game ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/2127030/Date_or_Destiny__Kiss_or_Miss/

In Date or Destiny: Kiss or Miss, guide Kaan through his love-filled adventure. Meet different girls, make your choices, and shape the course of the story. The right decisions may lead you to a happy ending, but every wrong step brings you closer to a bitter fate.

Developed by 
Erik Games aka @ErikGamesStudio
